rows.en: But Ankh, right now we've got no choice but to keep going, right?
But right now, we have no choice but to press on.
But right now, we have no choice but to press on.
But right now, we have no choice but to press on.
But right now, all we can do is press on...!!
But right now, we have no choice but to press on.
But right now, we have no choice but to press on.
I know that. Some of those revived kaiju should be around here somewhere.
So you managed to make it all the way here, did you?
We have been observing you all along, gathering your combat data.
All of it stored right here, in this "Memory Memory."
I see...! I kept sensing a Yummy's presence clinging to us,
so it was you two all along!!
Combat data in a Memory...? What on earth for?
Combat data in a Memory...? What are you plotting!?
Combat data? Dunno what for, but my awesome moves are all in that Memory, right!?
Combat data in a Memory...? What are you plotting!?

Combat data in a Memory...? What are you plotting!?
Combat data in a Memory...? What are you plotting!?
...It is for the "Ultimate Being" that will one day be born.
Heh heh heh heh... Now then, time for the finishing touch.
We'll be taking the last of our combat data.
But the Memory, at least... you'll never have it...
Then the "Memory Memory" left behind rose into the air and flew off somewhere.
...No good. We went and lost it.
...It's no use. We've lost sight of it.
...It's no use. We've lost sight of it.

notes.note: Speaker labels in table 0703 run one row late (e.g. #0.23 'sensed a Yummy' is labelled Female Yummy; #0.20 feminine line labelled Male). Speakers re-inferred: #0.3 Ankh, #0.4 first party variant, #0.19 Male, #0.20 Female, #0.21 Male, #0.22 Female, #0.23-24 Ankh.
Plural 'Yummies': the male and female Pteranodon Yummy appear together.
'Memory Memory' kept as a romanized Gaia Memory name in quotes as in the source; not in glossary.
Source has a stray kana typo before 'nani'; kisama rendered as 'you bastard'. Rough leader variant.
Speaker inferred as Ankh (or party leader); labels offset, row 0.42 absent.
Speakers of #0.43-0.51 inferred as the two Yummies; which one says each line is uncertain because rows 0.42/0.48/0.49 are missing from the table and labels are offset.
Subject of 'hand over' (the Yummy) recast as 'you'll never have it' to avoid guessing I/we; meaning kept.
Dropped subject of 'lost sight' restored as 'we' (the party chasing the Memory).

report: 80/80 rows. Table 0703 speaker labels offset by one row; speakers re-inferred from content. Yummy line attribution in #0.43-0.51 uncertain. New term: 'Memory Memory' (Gaia Memory), 'Ultimate Being'.
